description: Header file for the Fee module in an AUTOSAR-based Arctic Core platform, defining constants, error codes, function prototypes, and configuration macros for fee management.

methods.name: Fee_MainFunction
methods.description: Main function to handle Fee module tasks, called periodically.

methods.name: Fee_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode of the Fee module.

methods.name: Fee_Read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified block and offset.

methods.name: Fee_Write
methods.description: Writes data to a specified block.

methods.name: Fee_GetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the Fee module.

methods.name: Fee_GetJobResult
methods.description: Gets the result of the last Fee job.
